rationale: 06 and 07 only: weight 0.25 on the occluder-mask loss computed from PIXray-A bg_object_segmentation (07 kept with occluder supervision by user decision, 2026-09-14). No other method has an occluder loss.

06 and 07 train on PIXray-A train_occ.json (same images and target instances plus occluder masks). Their test loaders read test_occ.json only because the Oc* pipeline requires the field; every method, 06 and 07 included, is scored against data/PIXray/annotations/test.json.

06 and 07 use the Oc* variants of LoadAnnotations / RandomFlip / Resize / RandomCrop / PackDetInputs, which apply the same geometric operation to the occluder masks as to the target masks. Every transform parameter (flip probability, scale 512, ratio 0.5-1.5, crop 512, filter thresholds) is identical across all methods; only the type names differ.
06 states backend_args=None explicitly; the other configs omit it and LoadImageFromFile defaults to None.
SAM methods additionally import mmdet.occlu to register their model and transform classes. Importing registers classes and performs no computation.
Detector configs carry DetVisualizationHook with draw=False (writes nothing, touches no tensor); the SAM configs do not declare it.

Pretrained-weight-matched input handling. Detectors: ImageNet caffe-style mean/std as ResNet-101 expects, pad to a multiple of 32. SAM methods: SAM's RGB mean/std and fixed 512x512 padding required by the ViT-L positional embedding (06 uses the Oc variant that also pads occluder masks).

Detectors: ResNet-101 from torchvision ImageNet weights, stem and stage 1 frozen, BatchNorm statistics frozen (norm_eval), with FPN (01, 02) or AttFPN (03, 04, 08, 09, 09M). SAM methods: SAM ViT-L image encoder frozen except LoRA r=16 on qkv, parameter-free passthrough aggregator, RSSimpleFPN with LayerNorm, SAM positional embedding.
Detector family (MaskRCNN, CascadeRCNN, RSPrompterAnchor) and 08's PIDray R0/R1 image-level gate (BCE weight 0.1, gate applied at inference).

09 / 09M only: shared point-refinement head on Method 03 (P2 features, 196 training / 784 inference points, output grids 56 and 112). 09 and 09M differ only in the head type (attention vs matched MLP); verified separately.

Proposal budgets. 04: recall-enhanced RPN (anchor scales 4 and 8; 3000 pre-NMS / 3000 kept in training, 2000 / 2000 at test). 01: standard Mask R-CNN keeps 1000 training proposals against 2000 for the cascades (disclosed in the registry). 05 / 06: RSPrompter's anchor scales 4 and 8 and 1000 training proposals. Test-time detection settings (score 0.05, NMS 0.5, 100 detections, mask threshold 0.5) are identical for all.

RoI-head design with its standard training targets. 01: one Mask R-CNN stage, L1 box losses, 512 sampled RoIs, 28x28 mask targets. 02-04, 08, 09, 09M: three cascade stages at IoU 0.5/0.6/0.7, SmoothL1 (RPN beta 1/9), stage weights 1/0.5/0.25, 28x28 FCN mask targets. 05: RSPrompter anchor prompt head with the SAM mask decoder, 256 sampled RoIs and 512x512 mask targets. 06: the Occ bilayer SAM decoder and prompt head on the same design (with occluder supervision listed separately).
